marketing_copy.hook: Transform your hairstyling passion into a purpose-driven, profitable business—without losing your soul.
marketing_copy.meta_description: Master the art and business of hairstyling with this interactive guide blending Christian values, creative excellence, and entrepreneurial strategy for stylists.
marketing_copy.elevator_pitch: Curls & Contemplation is the first comprehensive guide that treats hairstyling as both sacred calling and serious business—combining 16 transformative chapters with interactive quizzes, journals, and worksheets to help stylists build careers of purpose, profit, and peace.
marketing_copy.tagline: The Hairstylist's Path to Purposeful Success
marketing_copy.value_proposition_short: Build a thriving hairstyling career aligned with your values, creative vision, and financial goals.
marketing_copy.value_proposition_long: Whether you're behind the chair, running a salon, or building your brand, Curls & Contemplation provides the strategies, mindset shifts, and practical tools you need to create lasting success on your own terms. Blend artistic mastery with financial wisdom, cultivate sustainable wellness practices, and build a business that reflects your deepest values.

unique_selling_points: Only hairstyling book integrating Christian values with business strategy
Interactive format with 22+ worksheets, quizzes, and journals
Addresses full career lifecycle (student to legacy builder)

Blend of inspirational and tactical content
